senses.zh: 有邊緣的；鑲邊的；有鋒刃的

examples.en: She wore a white blouse edged with delicate lace.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件鑲著細緻蕾絲邊的白襯衫。

examples.en: The tablecloth is edged in gold thread and looks quite elegant.
examples.zh: 這條桌巾以金線鑲邊，看起來相當優雅。

examples.en: Keep edged tools such as scissors out of the reach of small children.
examples.zh: 剪刀之類有鋒刃的工具要放在幼兒拿不到的地方。

senses.zh: 慢慢挪動；以些微差距領先

examples.en: The car edged forward slowly through the crowded market street.
examples.zh: 車子在擁擠的市場街道上緩緩前進。

examples.en: Our team edged ahead of the other class in the final minutes.
examples.zh: 我們這隊在最後幾分鐘以些微差距超前另一個班。

examples.en: He edged closer to the door so he could leave quietly.
examples.zh: 他悄悄往門邊挪近，好安靜地離開。

examples.en: She is a highly educated woman who speaks four languages.
examples.zh: 她是一位受過高等教育的女性，會說四種語言。

examples.en: Parents want their children to grow up to be educated citizens.
examples.zh: 父母希望孩子長大成為受過教育的公民。

examples.en: The doctor made an educated guess about the cause of the cough.
examples.zh: 醫生對咳嗽的原因做出有根據的推測。

examples.en: We ate grilled eel over rice for dinner at the night market.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐在夜市吃了烤鰻魚飯。

examples.en: The eel slipped out of my hands and fell back into the water.
examples.zh: 那條鰻魚從我手中滑出，掉回水裡。

examples.en: An eel looks like a snake, but it is actually a fish.
examples.zh: 鰻魚看起來像蛇，但牠其實是魚。

examples.en: Press this button to eject the disc from the player.
examples.zh: 按這個按鈕就能把光碟從播放機彈出來。

examples.en: The security guard had to eject the noisy fans from the stadium.
examples.zh: 保全人員必須把吵鬧的球迷請出體育場。

examples.en: The old machine began to eject smoke into the room.
examples.zh: 那台老機器開始往房間裡噴出煙。

examples.en: A few minutes elapsed before anyone answered the phone.
examples.zh: 幾分鐘過去了才有人接電話。

examples.en: Please do not open the lid until ten minutes have elapsed.
examples.zh: 在十分鐘過去之前，請不要打開蓋子。

examples.en: Several years elapsed before we met again at the reunion.
examples.zh: 好幾年過去後，我們才在同學會上再次見面。

examples.en: The electoral system in this country has changed several times.
examples.zh: 這個國家的選舉制度已經改變過好幾次。

examples.en: Voters must check the electoral list posted at the town hall.
examples.zh: 選民必須查看張貼在區公所的選舉名冊。

examples.en: Young people play a growing role in the electoral process.
examples.zh: 年輕人在選舉過程中扮演越來越重要的角色。

examples.en: The electorate will go to the polls on Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 全體選民將在週六早上前往投票。

examples.en: The mayor promised to listen more closely to the electorate.
examples.zh: 市長承諾會更用心傾聽選民的心聲。

examples.en: A large part of the electorate is under the age of thirty.
examples.zh: 選民中有很大一部分年齡在三十歲以下。

examples.en: An electron carries a negative electric charge.
examples.zh: 電子帶有負電荷。

examples.en: In science class we learned how an electron moves around the nucleus.
examples.zh: 在自然課上，我們學到電子如何繞著原子核運行。

examples.en: Each atom has electrons arranged in layers around its center.
examples.zh: 每個原子的電子都分層排列在中心周圍。

senses.zh: 高架的；偏高的；位置較高的

examples.en: The train runs on an elevated track above the busy road.
examples.zh: 這班列車行駛在繁忙道路上方的高架軌道上。

examples.en: The doctor found that his blood pressure was slightly elevated.
examples.zh: 醫生發現他的血壓略微偏高。

examples.en: The elevated position of the café gives guests a great view.
examples.zh: 那間咖啡廳位置較高，讓客人有絕佳的視野。

examples.en: The village sits at an elevation of two thousand meters.
examples.zh: 這座村莊位於海拔兩千公尺處。

examples.en: The elevation of the hiking trail rises quickly after the first kilometer.
examples.zh: 登山步道的高度在第一公里之後迅速上升。

examples.en: Her elevation to team captain surprised no one in the club.
examples.zh: 她升任隊長，社團裡沒有人感到意外。

examples.en: The teacher asked questions to elicit answers from the shy students.
examples.zh: 老師提問，好讓害羞的學生說出答案。

examples.en: The funny video elicited laughter from the whole audience.
examples.zh: 那支搞笑影片引起全場觀眾大笑。

examples.en: The survey aims to elicit honest opinions about school lunches.
examples.zh: 這項問卷旨在引出大家對學校午餐的真實意見。

examples.en: Please check your eligibility before you apply for the scholarship.
examples.zh: 申請獎學金之前，請先確認你是否具備資格。

examples.en: Proof of age is required to confirm eligibility for the discount.
examples.zh: 需出示年齡證明以確認是否符合折扣資格。

examples.en: His eligibility to play ended when his grades dropped.
examples.zh: 他的成績下滑後，就失去了比賽資格。

examples.en: Only a small elite can afford to live in this neighborhood.
examples.zh: 只有少數菁英負擔得起住在這個社區。

examples.en: The business elite of the city attended the charity dinner.
examples.zh: 這座城市的商界菁英出席了慈善晚宴。

examples.en: She hopes to join the elite of professional swimmers someday.
examples.zh: 她希望有一天能躋身頂尖游泳選手之列。

examples.en: He trained hard to join the elite swim team.
examples.zh: 他努力訓練，想加入菁英游泳隊。

examples.en: Elite athletes often practice for six hours a day.
examples.zh: 頂尖運動員往往每天練習六個小時。

examples.en: The company offers an elite service to its best customers.
examples.zh: 這家公司為最好的客戶提供頂級服務。

examples.en: The speaker moved the audience with her eloquence.
examples.zh: 講者以她的口才打動了觀眾。

examples.en: He spoke with great eloquence at the school farewell ceremony.
examples.zh: 他在學校的歡送典禮上口才出眾，說得非常動人。

examples.en: Her eloquence helped her win the English speech contest.
examples.zh: 她的口才幫助她贏得了英語演講比賽。

examples.en: The government placed an embargo on oil from the region.
examples.zh: 政府對該地區的石油實施禁運。

examples.en: The embargo made it hard for shops to buy foreign goods.
examples.zh: 禁運讓商店很難進口外國商品。

examples.en: Leaders agreed to lift the embargo after months of talks.
examples.zh: 領袖們經過數月談判後同意解除禁運。

examples.en: Passengers began to embark at nine o'clock.
examples.zh: 乘客九點開始登船。

examples.en: She will embark on a new career next month.
examples.zh: 她下個月將展開新的職涯。

examples.en: We embark on a project to clean up the beach.
examples.zh: 我們著手進行一項淨灘專案。

senses.zh: 尷尬；難堪；令人丟臉的事

examples.en: She turned red with embarrassment when she forgot her lines.
examples.zh: 她忘詞時尷尬得滿臉通紅。

examples.en: His loud phone call on the bus was a real embarrassment to his sister.
examples.zh: 他在公車上大聲講電話，讓他妹妹覺得很丟臉。

examples.en: To avoid embarrassment, check your speech again before the meeting.
examples.zh: 為了避免尷尬，開會前請再檢查一次你的發言稿。

examples.en: Workers embed steel bars in the concrete to make it stronger.
examples.zh: 工人把鋼筋嵌入混凝土中，使它更堅固。

examples.en: You can embed a video in your web page with a short code.
examples.zh: 你可以用一小段程式碼把影片嵌入網頁。

examples.en: The doctor said a small piece of glass was embedded in his foot.
examples.zh: 醫生說他的腳裡嵌著一小塊玻璃。

examples.en: This statue is meant to embody the spirit of the city.
examples.zh: 這座雕像是為了體現這座城市的精神。

examples.en: Our new teacher embodies patience and kindness.
examples.zh: 我們的新老師體現了耐心與善良。

examples.en: The song embodies the hopes of a whole generation.
examples.zh: 這首歌體現了整個世代的希望。

examples.en: A chicken embryo grows inside the egg for about three weeks.
examples.zh: 雞的胚胎在蛋裡大約發育三週。

examples.en: Scientists study the embryo to learn how animals develop.
examples.zh: 科學家研究胚胎，以了解動物如何發育。

examples.en: In the early stage, the human embryo is smaller than a grain of rice.
examples.zh: 人類胚胎在早期比一粒米還小。

examples.en: The emergence of smartphones changed the way we take photos.
examples.zh: 智慧型手機的出現改變了我們拍照的方式。

examples.en: The emergence of online shopping hurt many small stores.
examples.zh: 網路購物的興起打擊了許多小商店。

examples.en: We watched the emergence of the butterfly from its cocoon.
examples.zh: 我們看著蝴蝶從繭中出現。

examples.en: The old refrigerator began to emit a strange noise.
examples.zh: 那台舊冰箱開始發出奇怪的聲音。

examples.en: Cars emit gases that are harmful to the air.
examples.zh: 汽車排放出對空氣有害的氣體。

examples.en: The lamp emits a soft yellow light in the bedroom.
examples.zh: 這盞燈在臥室裡散發柔和的黃光。

senses.zh: 強調的；斷然的；壓倒性的

examples.en: She gave an emphatic no when we asked if she wanted dessert.
examples.zh: 當我們問她要不要甜點時，她斷然說不要。

examples.en: The coach was emphatic about the need to arrive on time.
examples.zh: 教練再三強調必須準時到達。

examples.en: Our team won an emphatic victory in the final game.
examples.zh: 我們隊在決賽中取得壓倒性的勝利。

examples.en: Scientists need empirical evidence to support their ideas.
examples.zh: 科學家需要實證證據來支持他們的想法。

examples.en: The study is based on empirical data collected over five years.
examples.zh: 這項研究是根據五年來蒐集的實證資料。

examples.en: The students ran an empirical test to see which plant grows faster.
examples.zh: 學生們進行了一項實證測試，看哪種植物長得比較快。

examples.en: The city plans to enact a new law on plastic bags.
examples.zh: 市政府計畫制定一項關於塑膠袋的新法規。

examples.en: The school board enacted a rule against using phones in class.
examples.zh: 校務會議通過了禁止在課堂使用手機的規定。

examples.en: Students will enact a scene from the story in class.
examples.zh: 學生們將在課堂上演出故事中的一幕。

examples.en: The zoo built a larger enclosure for the pandas.
examples.zh: 動物園為貓熊蓋了一個更大的圍欄。

examples.en: The enclosure with this letter shows the course schedule.
examples.zh: 這封信的附件列出了課程時間表。

examples.en: A tall fence forms an enclosure around the playground.
examples.zh: 一道高圍籬在遊樂場四周圍出一塊場地。

senses.zh: 無盡的；無邊無際的；沒完沒了的

examples.en: The desert seemed endless under the hot sun.
examples.zh: 在烈日下，沙漠看起來無邊無際。

examples.en: We listened to the teacher's endless stories about her trip.
examples.zh: 我們聽老師沒完沒了地講她的旅行故事。

examples.en: The park offers endless fun for children of all ages.
examples.zh: 這座公園為各年齡的孩子提供無盡的樂趣。

examples.en: A rich businessman endowed the school with a new library.
examples.zh: 一位富商捐贈了一座新圖書館給學校。

examples.en: Nature has endowed her with a beautiful singing voice.
examples.zh: 大自然賦予她一副美妙的歌喉。

examples.en: The family plans to endow a scholarship for students from low-income homes.
examples.zh: 這個家庭打算捐出一筆獎學金，給來自低收入家庭的學生。

examples.en: A cup of tea can energize you on a sleepy afternoon.
examples.zh: 一杯茶可以讓你在昏昏欲睡的下午恢復活力。

examples.en: The coach's speech energized the whole team before the game.
examples.zh: 教練的談話讓全隊在比賽前振奮起來。

examples.en: Morning exercise helps energize students for a busy school day.
examples.zh: 晨間運動有助於讓學生為忙碌的上學日充滿活力。

examples.en: Strict enforcement of the rules keeps the swimming pool safe.
examples.zh: 嚴格執行規定能維持游泳池的安全。

examples.en: Law enforcement officers directed traffic outside the stadium.
examples.zh: 執法人員在體育場外指揮交通。

examples.en: Enforcement of the new parking rule begins next Monday.
examples.zh: 新的停車規定將從下週一開始執行。

senses.zh: 已訂婚的；忙線的；忙於……的

examples.en: My cousin is engaged to a teacher she met in college.
examples.zh: 我表姊與她大學時認識的老師訂婚了。

examples.en: His line was engaged, so I tried again after lunch.
examples.zh: 他的電話忙線中，所以我午餐後又打了一次。

examples.en: He is engaged in a study of local birds.
examples.zh: 他正忙於一項本地鳥類的研究。

examples.en: Their engagement was announced at the family dinner.
examples.zh: 他們的訂婚消息在家庭聚餐上宣布。

examples.en: I have a prior engagement on Friday evening, so I cannot come.
examples.zh: 我週五晚上已有約，所以沒辦法來。

examples.en: Teachers try to increase student engagement in class discussions.
examples.zh: 老師們努力提高學生參與課堂討論的程度。

examples.en: A long silence ensued after the teacher asked the question.
examples.zh: 老師提出問題後，隨之而來的是一陣長長的沉默。

examples.en: If you ignore the warning, serious problems may ensue.
examples.zh: 如果你忽視警告，可能會隨之出現嚴重的問題。

examples.en: An argument ensued when both people wanted the last seat.
examples.zh: 兩個人都想要最後一個座位，爭執隨之發生。

examples.en: The job will entail some travel to other cities.
examples.zh: 這份工作會涉及到其他城市出差。

examples.en: Buying a house entails a lot of paperwork.
examples.zh: 買房子需要處理大量文件。

examples.en: Changing schools would entail moving to another town.
examples.zh: 轉學意味著要搬到另一個城鎮。

examples.en: My uncle is a camera enthusiast who owns twelve lenses.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是相機愛好者，擁有十二顆鏡頭。

examples.en: Soccer enthusiasts filled the café to watch the match.
examples.zh: 足球愛好者擠滿咖啡廳看比賽。

examples.en: The club welcomes any enthusiast of old movies.
examples.zh: 這個社團歡迎任何老電影的愛好者。

examples.en: The environmentalist asked students to stop using plastic straws.
examples.zh: 那位環保人士請同學們不要再使用塑膠吸管。

examples.en: Many environmentalists support the plan to plant more trees in the city.
examples.zh: 許多環保人士支持在市區多種樹的計畫。

examples.en: My aunt, an environmentalist, always brings her own shopping bag.
examples.zh: 我阿姨是環保人士，總是自備購物袋。

examples.en: We envisage a bright future for our small business.
examples.zh: 我們預想我們的小事業會有光明的未來。

examples.en: Nobody envisaged that the meeting would take four hours.
examples.zh: 沒有人想到這場會議會開四個小時。

examples.en: The architect envisaged a park in the middle of the town.
examples.zh: 建築師設想在城鎮中心蓋一座公園。

examples.en: The government sent an envoy to the international conference.
examples.zh: 政府派了一位特使出席國際會議。

examples.en: The envoy thanked the host country for its warm welcome.
examples.zh: 特使感謝東道國的熱情接待。

examples.en: As a trade envoy, she travels abroad to meet business partners.
examples.zh: 身為貿易特使，她常出國拜訪商業夥伴。

examples.en: Saliva contains an enzyme that helps break down food.
examples.zh: 唾液含有一種酵素，能幫助分解食物。

examples.en: Some soaps contain an enzyme that removes food stains.
examples.zh: 有些肥皂含有可去除食物汙漬的酵素。

examples.en: The enzyme in pineapple can make your tongue feel a little sore.
examples.zh: 鳳梨裡的酵素會讓你的舌頭有點刺痛。

senses.zh: 史詩般的；壯闊的；浩大的

examples.en: The film tells an epic story of a family crossing the ocean.
examples.zh: 這部電影講述一個家庭橫渡大洋的史詩般故事。

examples.en: They took an epic journey across the country by train.
examples.zh: 他們搭火車展開一趟橫越全國的壯闊旅程。

examples.en: Our class made an epic effort to clean the whole school.
examples.zh: 我們班為了打掃整間學校付出了浩大的努力。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to read an epic written long ago.
examples.zh: 老師要我們讀一部很久以前寫成的史詩。

examples.en: Homer wrote a famous epic about a long sea voyage.
examples.zh: 荷馬寫了一部關於漫長海上航行的著名史詩。

examples.en: The class performed a short scene from the epic.
examples.zh: 全班演出了這部史詩中的一小段場景。

examples.en: The invention of the printing press began a new epoch.
examples.zh: 印刷術的發明開創了一個新時代。

examples.en: This epoch of history is full of great changes.
examples.zh: 歷史上的這個時代充滿了重大的變化。

examples.en: Scientists call our current epoch the Holocene.
examples.zh: 科學家把我們現在所處的時代稱為全新世。

examples.en: Her high eq helps her get along well with every classmate.
examples.zh: 她的情商很高，讓她和每位同學都相處融洽。

examples.en: Good teachers need a strong eq as well as subject knowledge.
examples.zh: 好老師除了專業知識，也需要很高的情商。

examples.en: The company offers a workshop to help managers improve their eq.
examples.zh: 公司開辦了工作坊，幫助主管提升情商。

examples.en: The equator divides the earth into two halves.
examples.zh: 赤道把地球分成兩半。

examples.en: It is hot all year in countries close to the equator.
examples.zh: 靠近赤道的國家全年都很炎熱。

examples.en: Our ship crossed the equator on the fifth day.
examples.zh: 我們的船在第五天越過赤道。

examples.en: The gymnast lost her equilibrium and stepped off the beam.
examples.zh: 體操選手失去平衡，踩出了平衡木。

examples.en: Supply and demand reach equilibrium when prices stop changing.
examples.zh: 當價格不再變動時，供給與需求就達到均衡。

examples.en: Yoga helps me find mental equilibrium after a stressful week.
examples.zh: 瑜伽幫助我在壓力沉重的一週後找回心靈的平衡。

examples.en: Heavy rain can erode the soil on steep hills.
examples.zh: 豪雨會侵蝕陡峭山坡上的土壤。

examples.en: Waves slowly eroded the cliff near our hotel.
examples.zh: 海浪慢慢侵蝕了我們飯店附近的懸崖。

examples.en: Too many mistakes can erode customers' trust in a store.
examples.zh: 太多錯誤會逐漸削弱顧客對商店的信任。

examples.en: Soil erosion is a serious problem on steep farms.
examples.zh: 土壤侵蝕是陡坡農地的一大問題。

examples.en: Planting trees along the river helps prevent erosion.
examples.zh: 沿著河岸種樹有助於防止侵蝕。

examples.en: Years of erosion by the sea have made the beach narrower.
examples.zh: 多年來海水的侵蝕使沙灘變窄了。

examples.en: The library keeps erotic novels on a separate shelf for adults.
examples.zh: 圖書館把情色小說放在另一個專供成人的書架上。

examples.en: The museum explained why some erotic paintings were once banned.
examples.zh: 博物館解釋了為什麼有些情色畫作曾經被禁止展出。

examples.en: Critics say the film's erotic scenes are not suitable for teenagers.
examples.zh: 評論家認為這部電影的情色場面不適合青少年。

examples.en: The report contained an erroneous number that confused everyone.
examples.zh: 報告裡有一個錯誤的數字，讓大家都很困惑。

examples.en: He made an erroneous assumption about the exam date.
examples.zh: 他對考試日期做了錯誤的假設。

examples.en: Please correct any erroneous information on your form.
examples.zh: 請更正表格上任何錯誤的資訊。

senses.zh: 火山爆發；（情緒、聲音等）爆發

examples.en: The eruption of the volcano forced the villagers to leave the island.
examples.zh: 火山爆發迫使村民離開了那座島。

examples.en: Scientists use special tools to predict the next eruption.
examples.zh: 科學家使用特殊儀器來預測下一次火山爆發。

examples.en: An eruption of cheers filled the stadium after the goal.
examples.zh: 進球後，歡呼聲爆發，響徹體育場。

examples.en: The small disagreement began to escalate into a serious problem.
examples.zh: 這個小小的意見不合開始升級成嚴重的問題。

examples.en: Prices of food may escalate if the weather stays dry.
examples.zh: 如果天氣持續乾燥，食物價格可能會節節上漲。

examples.en: The company wants to escalate the matter to a senior manager.
examples.zh: 公司想把這件事上報給高階主管處理。
